targets.rawSql: SELECT (UNIX_TIMESTAMP() - MAX(CLOCK)) AS `Lag` FROM DT.HISTORY_PRED_RECURSIVE

panels.title: Prediction lag (s) — last MAX(CLOCK) in HISTORY_PRED_RECURSIVE

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ITEMID) AS Itemids FROM DT.HISTORY_PRED_RECURSIVE WHERE CLOCK > UNIX_TIMESTAMP() - 3600
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(METHOD='Hard') / COUNT(*) AS HardPct FROM DT.HISTORY_SELECTION_LOG_${selector_mode} WHERE CLOCK > UNIX_TIMESTAMP() - 3600
SELECT AVG(ABS(ACTUAL - ADAPTIVE_VALUE)) AS MAE FROM DT.HISTORY_SELECTION_LOG_${selector_mode} WHERE CLOCK > UNIX_TIMESTAMP() - 3600 AND ACTUAL IS NOT NULL AND ADAPTIVE_VALUE IS NOT NULL
